item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Lia Ochs, Hazleton Area
item.description: Hazleton Area swimmer Lia Ochs captured two individual gold medals and also helped a Lady Cougars relay team finish first at the District 2-4 Class 3A Swimming Championships at the Wyoming Valley CYC, Wilkes-Barre. The sophomore set a new school standard of 1:55.52 in winning the 200-yard freestyle, eclipsing Felicia Grego’s 11-year-old mark of 1:58.11.
